flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminui pages/Notice/hook/{useNoticeSubmit.tsx,useNoticeUploadSubmit.ts}, utils/mapping/Notice/Notice.ts. ocmsadminapi workflows/notice_creation/core/{CreateNoticeController (/staff-create-notice), CreateNoticeServiceImpl.processSingleNotice}, helpers/{NoticeValidationHelper, AdvisoryNoticeHelper, NoticeProcessingHelper, SpecialVehUtils, NoticeNumberHelper, NoticeRecordHelper}, crud/ocmsizdb/sequence/SequenceRepository, resources/api-authorization.properties. ocmsadminprivateapi, ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui, thirdpartyapi: not related
note: Status in the sheet is 'Demo paid (50% of 75%)'. Staff record offences through the form or an XLSX upload, then the same pipeline as the PLUS path checks mandatory fields, offence rule, DBB, AN, decides the vehicle type/stage, builds a unique notice number from a per-subsystem sequence and saves to VON/eVON. Gaps: the offence type (O/E/U/A/T) is picked by staff and not matched against the rule table; an exception in the DBB check is swallowed; the notice number sequence is formatted to 5 digits with no guard after 99999. Tickets: OCMS-SR-2026-101 and OCMS-DF-2026-102 (UPL defaults, Closed, the code is now correct), OCMS-DF-2026-188 (bulk create template, Pending UAT Verification, upload path only).
recommendation: Claimable for staff recording, automatic criteria and unique notice numbers. Tell URA the offence type is not validated against the rule table and ask for the sequence behaviour after 99999.

steps.step: Staff records the offence in OCMS (create notice form or XLSX upload)
steps.detail: The Staff Portal calls POST staff-create-notice for the single create form (useNoticeSubmit.tsx:37-52) and the bulk XLSX upload (useNoticeUploadSubmit.ts:147). The UI sets subsystemLabel "004" and anFlag N (Notice.ts:287-289). The server grants access through function OCMS_NOTICE_CREATE (api-authorization.properties:28-29) and the controller runs the same pipeline as the other channels (CreateNoticeController.java:34-38; CreateNoticeServiceImpl.java:181-183). Label 004 is not forced by the server on this path (unlike PLUS, CreateNoticeServiceImpl.java:451-475); the UI decides. Ticket OCMS-DF-2026-188 (bulk create template cannot be downloaded, status Pending UAT Verification) concerns the XLSX upload path, not the single form, so it does not lower the fit.

steps.step: OCMS checks the mandatory fields of the recorded offence
steps.detail: validateMandatoryFieldsForBatch requires compositionAmount, computerRuleCode, creDate, creUserId, noticeDateAndTime, offenceNoticeType, ppCode, ppName and vehicleCategory (NoticeValidationHelper.java:113-157); PLUS only (label 005) also requires vehicleNo and vehicleRegistrationType (:162-171). noticeNo is optional for labels 003-010, 020-021, 023 and 030-999 because OCMS generates the number (:84-103). Failed notices go to the failed list, the rest are still processed (CreateNoticeServiceImpl.java:499-531).

steps.step: OCMS checks the offence rule as part of the pre-defined criteria
steps.detail: getOffenseTypeFromRuleCode looks up computerRuleCode in the offence rule table and returns the offence type (O/E/U), stored in singleDtoMap as 'offenseType' (CreateNoticeServiceImpl.java:967-971; NoticeValidationHelper.java:315-346). The result is the gate for the DBB and AN checks. An unknown rule code throws RuntimeException so the notice fails and goes to the error collector (:347-349; CreateNoticeServiceImpl.java:972-980).

steps.step: OCMS checks the offence history (same offence already exists)
steps.detail: Before INSERT, checkDuplicateOffenseDetailsPreCreation searches for other notices with the same vehicleNo + computerRuleCode + ppCode and offence time (type O: date only; type E: date + hour + minute; others exact) and only counts it as a duplicate when the old notice is active, PS-FOR, PS-ANS (type O only), PS-FP/PRA or TS (NoticeValidationHelper.java:462-520). On a duplicate the notice is created with PS-DBB; if the query fails 3 times it is created with TS-OLD (NoticeProcessingHelper.java:69-122; CreateNoticeServiceImpl.java:1119-1124). An existing noticeNo is rejected right away as a duplicate (:958-965). One thing to watch out for: an unexpected exception in this method is swallowed and treated as not duplicate (NoticeValidationHelper.java:535-537).

AN is only checked when the offence type is O and the vehicle type is S/D/V/I (CreateNoticeServiceImpl.java:1175; AdvisoryNoticeHelper.java:99-107), then through exemption rules (ocmsAnExemptionRulesService, AdvisoryNoticeHelper.java:147-166) and past offences in the last 24 months: it qualifies when there is no past offence, or every past offence is already PS with an ANS reason (AdvisoryNoticeHelper.java:216-289). When qualified: an_flag=Y, payment_acceptance_allowed=N, eservice code ANS (NoticeProcessingHelper.java:124-142) and a PS-ANS record is created too. A vehicle already AN in the same batch is skipped (CreateNoticeServiceImpl.java:1168-1172). Notices from EHT/CES labels 030-999 use the sender's an_flag (:1052-1109).

steps.step: OCMS prepares the notice by vehicle type (stage, payment flag, suspension)
steps.detail: OCMS decides the vehicle registration type: X for empty/N.A plates, I for MID/MINDEF, otherwise D/V/S/F through SpecialVehUtils.checkVehregistration (CreateNoticeServiceImpl.java:1007-1039; SpecialVehUtils.java:43-80). Processing stage and payment flag are then set per type: X -> payment N, composition 0, eservice E4 (NoticeProcessingHelper.java:390-411); S/V/D -> NPA then ROV, payment Y, E1 (:422-445); F -> stage NPA/ROV and PS-FOR; I -> military (CreateNoticeServiceImpl.java:1128-1151). Tickets OCMS-SR-2026-101 and OCMS-DF-2026-102 (wrong UPL defaults) are Closed/Prod deployed and the code now sets N/0/E4 for type X.

steps.step: OCMS automatically creates the correct type of parking offence notice
steps.detail: The automatic notice variations exist (PS-ANS, PS-DBB/TS-OLD, PS-FOR, UPL, military). But the offence type (O/E/U/A/T) is chosen by staff in the form and sent as is (Notice.ts:261-277); anFlag is always sent as N from the UI (Notice.ts:287). The server does not derive or validate that type against the rule table; the offence type from the rule table (CreateNoticeServiceImpl.java:967-971) is only the DBB/AN gate (NoticeValidationHelper.java:140-143). So 'OCMS checks criteria to create the correct type' holds for suspension/stage variations, not for the offence type.

steps.step: OCMS generates a unique notice number for every notice
steps.detail: When noticeNo is empty, processNoticeNumber builds 10 characters: 1 year digit + 3 subsystem code digits + 5 sequence digits + 1 modulo-11 check digit (NoticeNumberHelper.java:27-61, 127-149). The sequence comes from a SQL Server sequence per owner ocmsizmgr.seq_notice_no_<owner> (SequenceRepository.java:65-68; NoticeNumberHelper.java:99) so numbers do not collide between requests; the subsystem label must be valid in the standard code table (NoticeNumberHelper.java:43-46). An existing noticeNo is rejected as a duplicate (CreateNoticeServiceImpl.java:958-965). One thing to watch out for: the sequence is formatted %05d (NoticeNumberHelper.java:102), so after 99999 the number gets 6 digits and the notice number length changes; whether the sequence is reset or cycled is in the DB definition, cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: The notice is saved so it can be processed in the next stages
steps.detail: The VON + OND records are saved in the intranet database (NoticeRecordHelper.java:156, batch saveAllNoRetry :380) and eVON/eOND in the internet database (NoticeRecordHelper.java:222). If the batch save fails every notice in the batch is marked failed (CreateNoticeServiceImpl.java:811-830) and the response lists success/failed/duplicate (CreateNoticeServiceImpl.java:844-851); a consolidated error email is sent when there are errors (:848). The next stage (ROV, or DN1 for UPL) is already set on the record (NoticeProcessingHelper.java:390-445).
